title_or_table: Public Law 119-75, Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, sections 6223, 6224, 6701 and 6702 (pharmacy benefit managers)
observation_period: February 3, 2026 (approved) to January 1, 2029 (last date in these sections)
universe_or_base: The pharmacy benefit manager provisions that V7 issue I084 names, with each provision's effective date as the law states it
vintage: Public law text on govinfo.gov as read on November 11, 2026
qualification: Dates tied to "plan years beginning on or after" a date reach each plan only when its next plan year starts. Two dates are computed by Oath & Action from the law's "18 months" and "30 months after the date of enactment" (February 3, 2026); they agree with V7's status text for issue I084 (checked October 15, 2026). The headings are the law's own; the effect lines are the studio's plain summaries of each section's opening rule, and the law has more requirements than each line names

date.description: date the part takes effect or is due

heading.description: the section heading as enacted, in sentence case

what_takes_effect.description: plain summary of what starts, written by the studio

kind.description: enacted, deadline, or plan years beginning on or after

date_basis.description: how the law sets the date; where Oath & Action computed a date from the law’s text, the cell says so (the wording is the studio’s, not the publisher’s)

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Public Law 119-75, Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, sections 6223, 6224, 6701 and 6702, February 3, 2026 to January 1, 2029, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Two dates computed from “months after enactment”; plan-year dates apply as each plan year begins.
notes: V7 issue I084 status (checked October 15, 2026): "Partly enacted. Public Law 119-75 (February 3, 2026) sets Medicare drug-plan fee and rebate pass-through rules from January 1, 2028, Medicare pharmacy contract standards from January 1, 2029, and rebate pass-through for employer plans for plan years beginning on or after August 3, 2028."
